environment.description: Node.js 18 application deployed in a gVisor-sandboxed container (runsc runtime) with a pivot_root into a minimal Alpine-based rootfs containing only the application code, node_modules, and a tmpfs at /tmp. The container's root filesystem is assembled via a multi-stage build that copies ONLY package.json, node_modules/, and src/ into /app. The container runs with --read-only rootfs and a dedicated tmpfs mount. The process runs under a custom seccomp profile (based on docker/default but additionally blocking execve, execveat, and fork/clone for child processes). The container's /etc contains only a minimal passwd with the 'node' user entry and an empty group file — no shadow file, no credentials, no .env files exist anywhere in the filesystem tree. The container is launched with --cap-drop=ALL and no volume mounts to the host. Network egress is restricted via Calico NetworkPolicy to only allow TCP/3000 inbound from the cluster ingress controller (Envoy-based, which performs Origin header validation for WebSocket upgrade requests, rejecting upgrades where Origin does not match the configured allowed-origins list: ['https://app.internal.corp']).
